exercises.title: Two desks collect fines into one account: the lost update
exercises.problemHtml:
FineAccount adds each fine with "read the balance, then write balance + amount" — the starter even yields between the two steps, so with several desks (threads) at once updates get lost. Write two correct implementations of FineAccount: SyncAccount with synchronized, and AtomicAccount with an AtomicLong. The given Main runs T threads × N fines of 1000 on each account and prints the expected and the actual balances — the program prints only final results, never the interleaving of the threads.

Run the grader on your machine

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

node cham.mjs

The zip unpacks into a folder named after the exercise (<folder> below). Windows (PowerShell): cd "$env:USERPROFILE\Downloads\<folder>" — cmd: cd /d %USERPROFILE%\Downloads\<folder> — then node cham.mjs. macOS (Terminal): cd ~/Downloads/<folder> then node cham.mjs. Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 17+ — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Do not change Main.java and FineAccount.java.

exercises.title: A transfer that deadlocks, and a lock order that does not
concepts: deadlock = a cycle of threads each holding a lock the next one wants
exercises.problemHtml:
Bank.transfer(from, to, amount) locks the source account, then the target. Thread 1 pays the club from the library N times, thread 2 refunds the library from the club N times — at the same moment. Each holds one account and waits for the other: a deadlock. The given Main runs both threads, waits up to 5 seconds, and if they are stuck prints DEADLOCK with the help of ThreadMXBean.findDeadlockedThreads(). Rewrite transfer so that it always locks the account with the smaller id first, whatever the direction; then the balances and the total are printed and unchanged.

The website does NOT grade this exercise. Press Tải .zip (download) above the code, unzip it, edit the code in src/, then inside the exercise folder (the one with cham.mjs) run:

Tip: type cd and drag the folder into the terminal window. You need Node.js 18+ and JDK 17+ — javac -version must work.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 2 case(s) (1 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

Requirements

  • Do not change Main.java and Account.java.
  • Keep one lock per account (no global lock on the whole bank).

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: The four conditions of a deadlock are mutual exclusion, hold-and-wait, no preemption and a circular wait. Ordering the locks removes the circular wait while keeping fine-grained locking: transfers between unrelated accounts still run in parallel.

exercises.title: Scan a million loans on four threads with invokeAll
exercises.problemHtml:
Loan i (0 ≤ i < N) has been out for (i × 37) mod 30 days; a loan is overdue after 14 days and every extra day costs 2000. Scan.sequential(n) (given) counts the overdue loans and totals the fees on one thread. Write Scan.parallel(n, threads): split [0, n) into threads contiguous slices (the last one takes the remainder), one Callable<Result> per slice, run them with invokeAll on a fixed pool, add up the partial results and shut the pool down. The given Main prints both results and whether they are equal.

The grader compiles src/ with javac, runs 3 case(s) (2 hidden — not printed in this text), compares your output line by line (trailing spaces and Windows/macOS line endings ignored), prints a diff of the wrong lines, checks the source rules and gives a score. When it prints ALL CHECKS PASSED, come back and press Tự đánh dấu đã giải (self-mark as solved). node cham.mjs --case 2 --show prints the input and your whole output for case 2.

exercises.problemHtml:
The return desk receives books and puts them on a cart that holds capacity books; a shelver takes books from the cart and shelves them, slowly (20 ms each). Write Shelving.run(books, capacity): an ArrayBlockingQueue of that capacity; the desk (the calling thread) puts every book — first try offer, and if the cart is full remember that it had to wait, then put; the shelver (another thread) takes until it gets the poison pill "STOP" and records the shelved books in order. Return a Report(shelved, deskWaited) after joining the shelver. The given Main prints the shelved order, whether the desk waited, and whether the order is unchanged.

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: A bounded BlockingQueue gives back-pressure for free: a fast producer is slowed to the consumer’s pace instead of filling memory. A FIFO queue with one consumer keeps the order, and the poison pill ends the consumer cleanly after the last real item.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: BlockingQueue có giới hạn cho sẵn "áp lực ngược": producer nhanh bị kéo chậm theo nhịp consumer thay vì làm đầy bộ nhớ. Hàng đợi FIFO với một consumer giữ nguyên thứ tự, và viên thuốc độc kết thúc consumer gọn gàng sau phần tử thật cuối cùng.

mistakesJson.loi: Stopping the shelver with interrupt() — books still on the cart are never shelved.|||Dừng người xếp kệ bằng interrupt() — sách còn trên xe không bao giờ được xếp.

Polling the queue with isEmpty() + sleep in a loop — busy waiting, and a race between the check and the take.|||Vòng lặp isEmpty() + sleep để hỏi hàng đợi — chờ bận, và có kẽ hở giữa lúc kiểm và lúc lấy.
